BiblicalUsage: Meqerah is the summer parlour, the cool upper room where a king sat alone. Judges 3:20 has Ehud come to Eglon in his summer parlour with a message from God, and Judges 3:24 has the servants find the doors locked and think the king is covering his feet in his summer chamber.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cool room is the picture of a king at ease who never saw the judgment coming through his own door.
